description: This file contains the abstract class Smarty_Internal_TemplateBase, which provides shared methods for handling Smarty templates, including methods for fetching, displaying, caching, and registering plugins or filters. It appears to be a core part of the Smarty templating engine's internal plugin system.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_TemplateBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing shared template handling methods for Smarty internal templates, facilitating fetching, displaying, cache management, and plugin registration.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Renders a Smarty template and returns it as a string.

methods.name: isCached
methods.description: Checks if the specified template cache is valid.

methods.name: _execute
methods.description: Internal method to execute the rendering, display, or cache check of a template.

methods.name: registerPlugin
methods.description: Registers a plugin for use within templates.

methods.name: loadFilter
methods.description: Loads a specified filter type and name.

methods.name: registerFilter
methods.description: Registers a filter function for templates.

methods.name: registerObject
methods.description: Registers an object to be used within templates.

methods.name: setCompileCheck
methods.description: Sets whether to check templates for modifications.

methods.name: setCacheLifetime
methods.description: Sets the cache lifetime in seconds.
